text:
Lena: Proposal: replace dual grace tiers with a single 60d default and introduce 'pin-deprioritization' — automated downgrade of pinned traffic to the current catalog default for low-touch tenants. Goal: reduce long-tail operational cost while preserving enterprise guarantees.

Sam: Runtime feasibility: yes. Need deterministic rules to avoid cold starts. Suggest gating by tokens/month < 100k AND stable eval pass rate for 30d.

Yuki: SRE asks: require shadowing for 10 days, sample diffs stored for offline QA, and a one-click tenant freeze. Alert if 99p latency up >12% or error-rate up >2%.

Omar: Product acceptance gates: (1) bench delta <=2% on prioritized slices, (2) rollback < 15m automated, (3) comm + opt-out UX live, (4) list of legal exceptions. Priya will own comms.

Priya: Draft canary config snippet we discussed:
```json
{"pin_deprioritize":true,"default_grace_days":"60","usage_threshold_tokens":"100000","shadow_days":"10","live_days":"7","rollback_sla_mins":"15"}
```

Lena: Action items: Sam -> feature flag + sim harness (due Thu), Yuki -> alerts + freeze API (due Fri), Priya -> comms + exception list (due Mon). ops-bot: schedule dry-run to staging 2026-04-08T01:00Z.

ops-bot: CI: feature/pin-deprioritize -> staging (dry-run) scheduled.
